# SHA-256 of every frozen contract file, re-derived on each CI platform
# before anything compiles. See .github/verify-candidate-digests.py.
#
# MEANING: "the frozen contract files are unchanged". Since SA-2B1a this no
# longer pins Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock or src/lib.rs, which runtime slices must
# edit; tests/dependency_provenance_v1.rs, pinned here together with its
# lock baseline, now guards every dependency instead. The SA-0 contract
# (source, specs, tests, fixtures) keeps its corrected-contract bytes, and
# the storage contract (spec/state-store-v1.md, its golden fixture) is
# frozen alongside it. It is not, and must never become, "whatever was
# committed last": a change to any listed file has to arrive with the reason
# it changed.
#
# SA-0D amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: it registers the pairing,
# grant-status and peer-error wire surfaces in spec/v1.md and adds `state`
# to PROTOCOL_FIELDS, so those five files carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2a1 adds spec/pairing-v1.md, the pairing wire contract (Noise
# framing, pairing ID derivations, producer order, receiver client). No
# existing line changed.
#
# SA-0E amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: it registers the receiver
# peer store surfaces (peers.json) in spec/v1.md, adds `host`, `peers` and
# `port` to LOCAL_ONLY_FIELDS, and makes the registry test compare its
# field sets with the spec table rows. spec/v1.md, src/security.rs, the
# consent fixture, tests/security_contract_v1.rs and spec/security-v1.md
# (which pins that test module's hash) carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2a2 adds spec/peer-store-v1.md, the receiver peer store contract
# (peers.json). spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the receiver claim
# now takes the Pair URL, and the attempt-record rule changed (a refusal
# sent before any commit removes the record its own connection created, a
# transport failure after the handshake ends the call, and a full record
# table no longer stops the client from connecting).
#
# SA-2B2a3 changed spec/pairing-v1.md on purpose: it adds the "Listener"
# section (bind re-validation, the 8-connection cap, per-connection
# identity, stop), and the low-order remote static non-claim became a
# rule: both handshake sides refuse an all-zero X25519 with the remote
# static.
#
# SA-2B2b1 adds spec/report-peer-v1.md, the producer side of the peer
# report path (static binding, refusal codes, limits, source seam, memory
# accounting, per-chunk authorization under the store turnstile).
# spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the Peer request key set now
# dispatches to the report path (F-10), the 4,096-byte cap applies to the
# three pairing surfaces only, and Listener::start takes the report state.
#
# SA-2B2b2 changed spec/report-peer-v1.md on purpose: it adds the
# "Receiver" section (fetch steps, error mapping, the shape gate, the
# measured decode reservation, receiver memory and non-claims) and the
# receiver acceptance map. spec/peer-store-v1.md changed on purpose: the
# grant guards (set_state and update_grant name the grantId, upsert refuses
# a lower authEpoch) and from_confirmed taking host and port from the grant.
#
# SA-0F amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: the control `status` success
# data may carry `null` for `bindHost` and `nodeLabel` (not configured yet),
# so a fresh install can answer `status`. spec/v1.md, src/security.rs,
# tests/security_contract_v1.rs and spec/security-v1.md carry new digests.
#
# SA-2B2c1 adds spec/control-v1.md, the local control wire contract (the
# control.sock admission rules and pathname exception, the handshake
# framing over the frozen control MACs, deadlines, the nine commands, the
# client). No existing line changed.
#
# SA-2B2c2 adds spec/runtime-v1.md, the runtime contract (assembly, the
# listener slot, stop order, the shutdown hook, the F-7 disable
# composition and the enable gate, the housekeeping schedule).
# spec/control-v1.md changed on purpose: listenConfigure calls the
# runtime's listen hook before its reply, the shutdown hook's effect is
# the runtime's, and status and pendingList leave out offers and pending
# records past expiresAt. spec/pairing-v1.md changed on purpose: the F-7
# disable-half non-claim now points at the runtime's entry points.
#
# SA-2B3a adds spec/cache-store-v1.md, the on-disk producer and receiver
# cache contract (flat pcache-/rcache- namespaces, file layout, caps and
# eviction, the three get reservations, failure semantics, non-claims).
# spec/state-store-v1.md changed on purpose: it describes the four cache
# primitives of the secure root (read_file_sized, list, remove_file,
# remove_stale_temps), lists the cache files in the root, and corrects the
# umask-evidence wording (storage doc todo d1-d2: the second CI run is now
# 43016382735 at fe1af3b, and the maintainer's Mac claim names the branch
# it takes and how that was observed).
#
# SA-2B3b changed spec/runtime-v1.md on purpose: the receiver pull entry
# point and its cache (Runtime::pull, Runtime::last_good, set_state before
# remove_peer on revoked or expired, the cache opened at start without
# retry), housekeeping's purge_expired and listener retry, the
# listenConfigure hook keeping a listener already on the stored address,
# the SA-2B3b acceptance map and three non-claims.
#
# SA-2C1 adds spec/install-v1.md, the install and uninstall contract (the
# frozen install_objects paths, the descriptor-relative directory walk,
# the autostart templates, the uninstall order and the purge rule). No
# existing line changed.
#
# SA-2B3cd adds spec/source-v1.md, the report source contract (engine pin
# and provenance exception, secure-root layout, owner inputs and the
# approved-scope record, report steps, D1 containment, non-claims), and
# the D1 fixtures tests/fixtures/v1/source/default-roots.json and
# environment-keys.json, and codex-duration-timing.jsonl (the engine's own
# Codex timing fixture, copied at the pin). tests/dependency_provenance_v1.rs changed on
# purpose: tokscale-core is the one git dependency allowed, pinned to a
# full SHA that the lock must repeat. The lock baseline fixture changed on
# purpose: it adds the 209 packages tokscale-core brings, four fields each.
# Review fix: spec/source-v1.md now fixes the ownerInputsSha256 encoding in
# this crate (an engine pin cannot move it) and points at the state-store
# spec's own statement of the tokscale-core exception.
#
# SA-0G amended the SA-0 contract on purpose: control command 10
# `sharingSet{enabled}` and 11 `scopeApprove{ownerInputsSha256}` (64
# lowercase hex), both with `null` success data; the `status` success data
# gains the required bool `scopeApproved`; the source scope record
# (`generation,ownerInputsSha256,schema`) is a registered localOnlyFields
# surface; `enabled`, `scopeApproved` and `ownerInputsSha256` join
# protocolFields, `generation` and `ownerInputsSha256` join localOnlyFields.
# spec/v1.md, src/security.rs, tests/security_contract_v1.rs, the consent
# fixture and spec/security-v1.md carry new digests. spec/control-v1.md
# (the server answers `internal` to 10 and 11 until SA-2C2b; status reads
# scopeApproved from a scope provider) and spec/source-v1.md (points at the
# registered record and at scopeApprove) changed on purpose.
#
# SA-2C2b adds spec/cli-v1.md, the standalone binary contract (`run`, the
# release gate on the debug home, the menu items and what each sends, the
# three direct store operations, SecureRoot::open_read_only, non-claims).
# spec/control-v1.md changed on purpose: sharingSet and scopeApprove run
# the hooks the server was started with (internal without one), and the
# scope provider is given the store. spec/runtime-v1.md changed on
# purpose: Runtime::start_with_scope and the sharingSet hook over the
# same enable gate and F-7 disable bodies. spec/agent-v1.md changed on
# purpose: the scope hooks Agent::start passes and the digest check of
# scopeApprove.
# SA-2C2b review fixes changed spec/cli-v1.md, spec/control-v1.md and
# spec/agent-v1.md on purpose: the client's NoReply (sent, outcome
# unknown) apart from Socket (nothing sent), the read-only read accepting
# an unlinked file, grants listed without creating state and without
# holding the lock at the prompt, and Agent::uninstall_stopped.
#
# SA-2D changed spec/pairing-v1.md on purpose: the "Initiator connect" row
# no longer says name resolution runs outside the handshake deadline. The
# 10 s deadline now starts before resolution; an IP literal skips the
# resolver, and a hostname is resolved on a helper thread that the call
# stops waiting for at the deadline.
# The deadline table row there and step 4 of spec/report-peer-v1.md said
# "connect plus handshake"; both now name resolution too.
#
# SA-3e changed spec/runtime-v1.md on purpose: Runtime::remove_peer
# (PeerStore::remove first, durable, its error returned with the cache
# untouched; then CacheStore::remove_peer with its result ignored, as in
# pull's revoked or expired step) and its acceptance row. It deletes the
# entries that exist when it runs; a pull running at the same time may
# still write one entry afterwards, which no record can read and which
# expiry deletes. pull itself is unchanged. The last_good paragraph now
# scopes "left to expiry and eviction" to a replaced record or one removed
# through PeerStore::remove alone.
#
# Engine pin moved to tokscale-core b0e2e5f4 (the streaming source fold no
# longer refuses on local history size). Changed on purpose: the 40-hex pin
# in spec/source-v1.md, the lock baseline fixture and the two D1 fixtures'
# engineSha, and the spec sentence saying where that SHA comes from. The D1
# fixtures' cited engine line numbers still hold: src/clients.rs,
# src/scanner.rs and src/source_context.rs are identical at both pins.
#
# Engine pin moved to tokscale-core 51047602 (a stale price table prices a
# shared report instead of zeroing its cost). Changed on purpose: the 40-hex
# pin in spec/source-v1.md, the lock baseline fixture and the two D1
# fixtures' engineSha; the PR number in the spec's provenance sentence; the
# spec's "nothing writes pricing files" sentence, now scoped to this crate; and
# spec/cli-v1.md, which now says pricing files left in the shared root by an
# app keep pricing the standalone agent. The D1 fixtures' cited engine line
# numbers still hold: the engine delta touches src/pricing/mod.rs and
# tests/remote_source_report.rs only.
#
# DR-1e changed spec/cli-v1.md and spec/source-v1.md on purpose. The
# standalone binary's config and data dirs (cli::default_dirs) are now
# home/.config and home/.local/share on macOS as on Linux, instead of
# Library/Application Support for both: the engine's remote context
# substitutes them for the XDG data root and the TOKSCALE_CONFIG_DIR base,
# so the old dirs missed every client the engine's local report lane finds
# under .local/share or .config/tokscale (OpenCode, Muse, Antigravity and
# others). spec/cli-v1.md states the new dirs; spec/source-v1.md now says a
# change to an assembler's default roots changes the owner inputs and is a
# consent change (re-approval, old grants stop authorizing), not a D1 case.
#
# DR-2b (2026-11-16) amended the SA-0 contract on purpose; the owner
# approved adding `nodeLabel` and `costIncomplete` to the Peer response
# envelope. The envelope has 17 required keys: `nodeLabel` (the producer's
# config.nodeLabel, or null when unset or failing security::valid_node_label)
# and `costIncomplete` (the producer's pricing table was missing or corrupt).
# REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 1 -> 2 (one version only; a producer answers
# another reportSchema with code 6). PEER_PROTOCOL_VERSION and every pairing,
# SAS and offer byte are unchanged (sas.txt, pair_url.txt keep their
# digests). Changed: spec/v1.md (report schema, envelope row,
# protocolFields), src/security.rs (the schema constant, `costIncomplete` in
# PROTOCOL_FIELDS, valid_node_label), src/report.rs (the two fields, the
# label read as null on decode), the consent fixture, the four report golden
# bodies (schema 2; agents.json also pins a label and costIncomplete true),
# the cache golden key, file name and body digest (schema 2 in the key, the
# new body), tests/report_cache_v1.rs, tests/security_contract_v1.rs and
# spec/security-v1.md (which pins its hash), spec/report-cache-v1.md,
# spec/report-peer-v1.md (step 4 code 6, the source seam's label, Fetched,
# code 6 -> Incompatible, 17 response keys, the cost model's 13-17 note,
# the DR-2b acceptance map) and spec/peer-store-v1.md (nodeLabel is the
# producer's name, a failing label loads as null, set_label). Also changed:
# the cache golden metadata (tests/fixtures/v1/cache/metadata.json: the
# body digest and reportSchema 2 in its key); spec/agent-v1.md (code 6 is
# its own Incompatible outcome, classified Refused); spec/runtime-v1.md
# (pull calls set_label after a success; ever_answered); spec/source-v1.md
# (report takes node_label; how nodeLabel and costIncomplete are set).
# DR-2b review round 1: src/security.rs (a label needs one visible
# character: not whitespace nor one of INVISIBLE_LABEL_CHARS), src/report.rs
# (comment: only a decodable label is dropped alone), spec/report-cache-v1.md
# (the rule restated; a non-NFC or over-255-byte label refuses the body;
# schema-1 cache entries are deleted at open), spec/peer-store-v1.md (a
# failed set_label reloads peers.json instead of going sticky unknown; the
# upsert example), spec/state-store-v1.md (set_listen_config: NFC, a changed
# label passes the rule, an unchanged stored one is not re-validated; load
# checks 128 bytes only), spec/runtime-v1.md and spec/report-peer-v1.md.
#
# DR-3a (2026-11-17) changed spec/pairing-v1.md and spec/runtime-v1.md on
# purpose; the owner decided that grants should last very long and that a
# new approval ends the same device's older grants. spec/pairing-v1.md: the
# grant lifetime is 100 years (pairing::GRANT_LIFETIME_MS) and why
# (revocation, not expiry, ends access; grants approved earlier keep their
# expiry); "Approval" now states that approve revokes every other active
# grant of the same initiatorStatic with the frozen revoke_commit (its
# ordering and failure rules are the review round's, below), that other
# devices' grants are not revoked but have their authEpoch renumbered as by
# any revoke, and that a receiver removing the producer on its own side
# keeps access until the producer revokes. spec/runtime-v1.md: the
# housekeeping sentence no longer says the sweep routinely frees the
# sixteen active-grant slots. src/security.rs is unchanged: the same-device
# revoke lives in src/pairing.rs (not digest-pinned). No wire, schema or
# SAS byte changed.
#
# DR-3a review round (2026-11-17) changed spec/pairing-v1.md,
# spec/runtime-v1.md, spec/control-v1.md and spec/security-v1.md on
# purpose. pairing::approve now revokes the pending initiator's active
# grants and approves in ONE transition, revocations first, all or
# nothing; this replaces the two-transition order of the first DR-3a
# commit. spec/pairing-v1.md "Approval" states that rule (a refused or
# failed approval revokes nothing; re-pairing succeeds at sixteen grants,
# a seventeenth static is refused; each revocation's terminal record
# counts before the record-table check; the new grant's epoch is final;
# two pendings of one static end with the last approved) and two accepted
# limits (the old grant ends at the owner's approval, not at the
# receiver's take-up; other devices get code 2 once and the embedding app
# refreshes them). spec/runtime-v1.md: pull step 4 leaves the cache alone
# when set_state is Refused(Conflict) (the record holds a newer grant),
# plus its acceptance row. spec/control-v1.md: the approve row says it
# ends that device's earlier grant. spec/security-v1.md: the Approve row
# says it is the reference transition alone and that pairing::approve
# composes Revoke with it; the frozen transition itself is unchanged.
#
# W2 changed spec/control-v1.md and spec/runtime-v1.md on purpose: the
# in-process control entry Runtime::control. spec/control-v1.md gains the
# "In-process entry" section (the platform-independent, crate-private
# dispatcher shared with the socket server and never given to a Listener or
# ReportSource; the eight commands, shutdown/sharingSet/scopeApprove
# invalid; the frozen verify_control_command on a client-built envelope and
# verify_control_response with RESPONSE_JSON_MAX; no MAC, peer check, slot
# or deadline, and why; the stopped flag under a read-write lock and
# ControlError::Stopped; the caller duties) and its W2 acceptance table, and
# the platform paragraph now says Windows uses that entry. spec/runtime-v1.md
# states the compile-time Windows no-server rule (macOS and Linux still fail
# the start when the server does not start), Runtime::socket_path on macOS
# and Linux only, assembly step 3's dispatcher, stop step 1a, the into_store
# wording, and the "In-process control" section. No wire, command ID,
# result code, MAC or state byte changed; src/control.rs and src/runtime.rs
# are not digest-pinned.
#
# W1 (SA-2B1b, Windows secure storage) changed spec/state-store-v1.md on
# purpose: it adds the "Windows" section (LocalAppData known-folder base,
# handle-relative NtCreateFile descent with FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, the
# explicit owner-only protected descriptor, the base/intermediate and
# root/file DACL rules, persistent-ACL and network-volume checks, the
# FileRenameInformationEx POSIX replace with no directory sync, handle
# deletes, LockFileEx, the LOCALAPPDATA and USERPROFILE results, the
# Windows non-claims, and the uncovered stub for other targets); the Root
# table's Windows row and the environment sentence are scoped per platform;
# and the dependency paragraph names windows-sys =0.61.2 (already in the
# baseline, replacing the contract's 0.59.x) and the tuple allowlist.
# tests/dependency_provenance_v1.rs changed on purpose: the Windows target
# table is allowed, a package outside the baseline is accepted only by its
# full (name, version, source, checksum) tuple and the allowlist must equal
# what the lock adds (empty), with controls for a changed checksum, a
# changed version and a path package. The lock baseline fixture is
# unchanged: the lock gained no package.
#
# W3a (2026-11-21): engine pin moved to tokscale-core 2378f31a (the merge of
# its PR 91: RemoteSourceContextV1::new_with_xdg_data_home and
# preview_fingerprint_with_xdg_data_home, a separate XDG data root for a
# remote scan). Changed on purpose: the 40-hex pin and the provenance
# sentence in spec/source-v1.md, and the lock baseline fixture (the
# tokscale-core source line only; the lock gained no package). Both D1
# fixtures, tests/fixtures/v1/source/default-roots.json and
# tests/fixtures/v1/source/environment-keys.json, were derived again at
# 2378f31a: engineSha, and every cited src/source_context.rs line (the only
# engine src/ file the delta touches; 189->237, 194->242, 198->246,
# 519->579, 1133->1197); default-roots.json also says that the dataDir base
# (the XDG data root) is the separate XDG data root when one is given, and
# that the approved roots of admits_scan_root include it. The per-pin
# SEC-R4 requirement of spec/source-v1.md is met by tokscale-core PR 91: its
# three-platform CI, its fresh-context verifier and the security review of
# that change. spec/source-v1.md, spec/agent-v1.md and spec/cli-v1.md now
# describe the optional XDG data root: EngineSource::new_with_xdg_data_home,
# AgentConfig::xdg_data_home (None from AgentConfig::new), xdgDataHome in
# the owner-inputs digest only when set (so every existing digest is
# unchanged), and the disclosure line shown only when it is set.
